span.p: 1. 詳細工單排程 (Finite Scheduling)機台分派、甘特圖動態調整

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: 3. 產品生產履歷 (Genealogy/Traceability)正反向追溯 (人、機、料、法、環 4M1E)

span.p: 4. 現場資料收集 (Data Collection)條碼/RFID 刷讀、自動機連採集

span.p: 5. 電子作業指導書 (E-SOP / Document Control)版本防錯派發、無紙化點檢

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: 6. 即時品管 (Online SPC / Quality Management)製程不良鎖定、檢驗數據紀錄
